title: Agent Workflow Lock
description: A lease claiming a work item for an agent. Documentation of shape only — the runtime gate is the hand-rolled validateLock() in core/locks (zero-dependency by design). The `prd` pattern below shows the DEFAULT id pattern; runtime validation derives the actual pattern from workflow.config idPattern.

phase.description: Workflow phase name. Whether the phase counts as execution (claims its conflict surface) comes from workflow.config executionPhases.

branch.description: Optional git branch the agent is working on (v2).

worktree.description: Optional repo-relative worktree path (v2). Required when set: must start with the configured worktree dir (default `.worktrees/`).

ownedPaths.description: Optional glob patterns this work item claims exclusive write-ownership of, for path-level conflict detection (v2). Consumed by the path-conflict gate in core/locks.
